notes.title: Patch note - 2020.04.10
notes.notes: An error has been fixed in the swamp block (the block where the character slowly dives) where the jump button is not working.

notes.title: "Jumping Mellow" can enjoy the demo version.
notes.notes:
Do you hesitate to buy it?

Then play the demo version! Then you can find the demo version on the right side of the store page now. 

Only one stage can be played in the demo version. But don't be disappointed. This stage is only for demo versions.

Have it fun :D

notes.title: Patch note - 2020.03.26
notes.notes: There were opinions that the level of difficulty of the stage was too difficult. So the level of difficulty from stage 1 to 30 was corrected.
